newsitem.title: USA: FORE sees Q1 net, EPS below prior Q1.
newsitem.headline: FORE sees Q1 net, EPS below prior Q1.

text.p: FORE Systems Inc said early Tuesday that it expects to post first quarter net income of between $4.7 million and $6 million, or between $0.05 and $0.06 per share, on revenues of between $95 million and $97 million..
In the prior year's first quarter, the company had net income of $11.4 million, or $0.12 per share, on revenues of $83.4 million.

FORE Chairman and Chief Executive Eric Cooper said in a statement that the period's results were affected by a number of factors, including "slower overall growth in the networking industry, continued weakness in international markets, longer sales cycles for large enterprise networks and market confusion over competing networking technologies," he said in the statement.
Final financial results for FORE's first fiscal quarter ending June 30, 1997 are expected to be released on July 22.
FORE Systems designs, develops, manufactures and sells networking products based on ATM (asynchronous transfer mode) technology.
